lines.text: Hello, little gardener! Let’s count to five together.
One.
Two.
Three.
Four.
Five.
Six.
Seven.
Eight.
Nine.
Ten.
This is six. Say it with me. Six!
Let’s grow 6 flowers. Count with me.
6 flowers! Each flower has its own space.
Let’s write six. Follow the dots.
This is seven. Say it with me. Seven!

This is ten. Write one, then zero. Together, ten!
Give Coco 6 strawberries. Tap or drag them into the basket. Tap the tick when you are ready.
Give Coco 8 strawberries. Tap or drag them into the basket. Tap the tick when you are ready.
Give Coco 10 strawberries. Tap or drag them into the basket. Tap the tick when you are ready.
Find 7 butterflies. Tap the matching group.
Find 6 butterflies. Tap the matching group.
Find 8 butterflies. Tap the matching group.
How many butterflies do you see? Tap the number.
Let’s count together. We can try again.
You made the party! Pick a number and see what appears.
Pick a number and see what appears.
Write one, then zero. Together, ten!
Hooray! You explored numbers one to ten. What a wonderful garden party!
